symbol: Web API GET and HEAD requests with a body
title: Slack: Web API GET and HEAD requests with a body (behavior change)
summary: On February 17th, 2027, the Web API will start rejecting HTTP GET and HEAD requests that include a request body. These requests will fail with an HTTP 400 error (HTTP 403 once enforced at the CloudFront edge
replacement: Send GET arguments in the query string, send the token in the Authorization: Bearer header, and drop the request body. Or use POST, which supports URL-encoded and JSON-encoded bodies.
